theorem analyticGermAlong_of (v : E) (f : E → ℝ) (hf : AnalyticAt ℝ f 0) :

    (v : Fin (p + 1) → ℝ) (hv : v ≠ 0) :

name: AbelFormalization.exists_regularizing_coordinate_linearChange
statement:
theorem exists_regularizing_coordinate_linearChange {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ]

    ∃ e : (σ → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (σ → ℝ),

name: AbelFormalization.exists_regularizing_linearChange
statement:
theorem exists_regularizing_linearChange (p : ℕ) (g : RealAnalyticGerm (p + 1))
    (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ e : (Fin (p + 1) → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin (p + 1) → ℝ),
      analyticGermAlong (Pi.single 0 1) (analyticGermLinearChange e g) ≠ 0

name: AbelFormalization.exists_regularizing_linearChange_order
statement:
theorem exists_regularizing_linearChange_order (p : ℕ) (g : RealAnalyticGerm (p + 1))
    (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ e : (Fin (p + 1) → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin (p + 1) → ℝ),
      ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ u : AnalyticGermAt (0 : ℝ), IsUnit u ∧
        analyticGermAlong (Pi.single 0 1) (analyticGermLinearChange e g) =
          analyticGermParameter 0 ^ n * u

name: AbelFormalization.exists_regularizing_linearChange_positive_order
statement:
theorem exists_regularizing_linearChange_positive_order (p : ℕ)
    (g : RealAnalyticGerm (p + 1)) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hunit : ¬ IsUnit g) :
    ∃ e : (Fin (p + 1) → ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (Fin (p + 1) → ℝ),
      ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ u : AnalyticGermAt (0 : ℝ), IsUnit u ∧
        analyticGermAlong (Pi.single 0 1) (analyticGermLinearChange e g) =
          analyticGermParameter 0 ^ n * u

name: AbelFormalization.analyticOnNhd_analyticRemainder
statement:
theorem analyticOnNhd_analyticRemainder {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (ball (0 : ℂ) R)) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (analyticRemainder f) (ball (0 : ℂ) R)

name: AbelFormalization.analyticRemainder_eq_div
statement:
theorem analyticRemainder_eq_div (f : ℂ → ℂ) {q : ℂ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    analyticRemainder f q = (f q - f 0) / q

name: AbelFormalization.analyticRemainder_identity
statement:
theorem analyticRemainder_identity (f : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ) :
    f q = f 0 + q * analyticRemainder f q

name: AbelFormalization.analyticRemainder_zero
statement: theorem analyticRemainder_zero (f : ℂ → ℂ) : analyticRemainder f 0 = deriv f 0

name: AbelFormalization.exists_bounded_analytic_remainder
statement:
theorem exists_bounded_analytic_remainder {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R S : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (ball (0 : ℂ) R))
    (hbound : ∀ q ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖f q‖ ≤ S) :
    ∃ H : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ H (ball (0 : ℂ) R) ∧
      (∀ q : ℂ, f q = f 0 + q * H q) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖H q‖ ≤ 2 * S / R

name: AbelFormalization.norm_analyticRemainder_le
statement:
theorem norm_analyticRemainder_le {f : ℂ → ℂ} {R S : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f (ball (0 : ℂ) R))
    (hbound : ∀ q ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R, ‖f q‖ ≤ S)
    {q : ℂ} (hq : q ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R) :
    ‖analyticRemainder f q‖ ≤ 2 * S / R

name: AbelFormalization.artinianPolynomialSubmoduleDegree_length_eq_sum_layer_finranks
statement:
theorem artinianPolynomialSubmoduleDegree_length_eq_sum_layer_finranks
    [IsArtinianRing B] (I : Ideal B) [I.IsMaximal]
    (N : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) B) (artinianFreePolynomialModule B n r))
    (weight : Fin n → ℕ) (hweight : ∀ i, 0 < weight i)
    (shift : Fin r → ℤ) (degree : ℤ) {e : ℕ} (he : I ^ e = ⊥) :
    Module.length B (artinianPolynomialSubmoduleDegree N weight shift degree) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range e,
        (submoduleLayerResidueFinrank I
          (artinianPolynomialInducedDegreeFiltration I N weight shift degree i)
          (artinianPolynomialInducedDegreeFiltration I N weight shift degree (i + 1))
          (artinianPolynomialInducedDegreeFiltration_smul_le
            I N weight shift degree i) : ℕ∞)

name: AbelFormalization.exists_artinianPolynomialSubmoduleDegree_length_eq_sum_layer_finranks
statement:
theorem exists_artinianPolynomialSubmoduleDegree_length_eq_sum_layer_finranks
    [IsLocalRing B] [IsArtinianRing B]
    (weight : Fin n → ℕ) (hweight : ∀ i, 0 < weight i) (shift : Fin r → ℤ) :
    ∃ e : ℕ, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B ^ e = ⊥ ∧
      ∀ (N : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) B)
          (artinianFreePolynomialModule B n r)) (degree : ℤ),
        Module.length B (artinianPolynomialSubmoduleDegree N weight shift degree) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range e,
            (submoduleLayerResidueFinrank (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
              (artinianPolynomialInducedDegreeFiltration
                (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) N weight shift degree i)
              (artinianPolynomialInducedDegreeFiltration
                (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) N weight shift degree (i + 1))
              (artinianPolynomialInducedDegreeFiltration_smul_le
                (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) N weight shift degree i) : ℕ∞)

      ∀ N : Submodule R V, Module.length R N =

            (N ⊓ idealPowerSubmodule (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) i)

    (shift : κ → ℤ) (degree : ℤ) :

        (((monomialUpperFamilySubmodule (R := K) U).restrictScalars K ⊓
          weightedPolynomialModulePiece weight shift degree) :
            Submodule K (κ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) =
      (monomialUpperFamilyTerms U ∩ shiftedModuleDegreeTerms weight shift degree).ncard

name: AbelFormalization.monomialUpperFamily_fixed_weightedPieceDimensions_finite

        ∀ degree, Module.finrank K

            Submodule K (κ → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) = h degree}.Finite

name: AbelFormalization.exists_finset_monomialUpperFamily_cover

theorem exists_finset_monomialUpperFamily_cover
    (U : κ → UpperSet (Fin n → ℕ)) :

      (∀ t ∈ s, (t.2 : Fin n → ℕ) ∈ U t.1) ∧
      ∀ k (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ), (d : Fin n → ℕ) ∈ U k →
        ∃ u ∈ s, u.1 = k ∧ u.2 ≤ d

name: AbelFormalization.finite_monomialUpperFamily_cover_degree_bound

    ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ U ∈ F, ∃ s : Finset (κ × (Fin n →₀ ℕ)),
      (∀ t ∈ s, (t.2 : Fin n → ℕ) ∈ U t.1) ∧
      (∀ k (d : Fin n →₀ ℕ), (d : Fin n → ℕ) ∈ U k →
        ∃ u ∈ s, u.1 = k ∧ u.2 ≤ d) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ s, grade t ≤ (D : ℤ)

name: AbelFormalization.monomialUpperFamily_fixed_weightedCounts_cover_degree_bound

    (weight : Fin n → ℕ) (hweight : ∀ i, 0 < weight i)

statement:
theorem finiteGreatestCoordinates_polynomialModuleCoordinates_iff

statement:
theorem finrank_polynomialModule_weightedPiece_eq_initial
    (m : MonomialOrder (Fin n)) (weight : Fin n → ℕ) (hweight : ∀ i, 0 < weight i)

    (N : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
    (hN : IsWeightedPolynomialModuleHomogeneous weight shift N) (degree : ℤ) :

name: AbelFormalization.polynomialModuleLeadingTerms_weightedPiece
statement:
theorem polynomialModuleLeadingTerms_weightedPiece
    (m : MonomialOrder (Fin n)) (weight : Fin n → ℕ) (shift : Fin r → ℤ)
    (N : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
    (hN : IsWeightedPolynomialModuleHomogeneous weight shift N) (degree : ℤ) :
    polynomialModuleLeadingTerms m

      monomialUpperFamilyTerms (polynomialModuleLeadingUpperFamily m N) ∩
        shiftedModuleDegreeTerms weight shift degree

name: AbelFormalization.exists_finite_polynomialModule_generators_of_leading_witnesses
statement:
theorem exists_finite_polynomialModule_generators_of_leading_witnesses

    (H : (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) → Prop)
    (hH : ∀ t, (∃ P ∈ N, IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m P t) →
      ∃ Q ∈ N, H Q ∧ IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m Q t) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
      (∀ Q ∈ S, Q ∈ N ∧ H Q) ∧

name: AbelFormalization.exists_finite_polynomialModule_leading_representatives
statement:
theorem exists_finite_polynomialModule_leading_representatives
    (m : MonomialOrder (Fin n))
    (N : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K))
    (H : (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) → Prop)
    (hH : ∀ t, (∃ P ∈ N, IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m P t) →
      ∃ Q ∈ N, H Q ∧ IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m Q t) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
      (∀ Q ∈ S, Q ∈ N ∧ H Q) ∧
      ∀ P ∈ N, ∀ t, IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m P t →
        ∃ Q ∈ S, ∃ u, IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m Q u ∧
          u.1 = t.1 ∧ u.2 ≤ t.2

name: AbelFormalization.exists_polynomialModule_generators_from_leadingCover
statement:
theorem exists_polynomialModule_generators_from_leadingCover

    (s : Finset (Fin r × (Fin n →₀ ℕ)))
    (H : (Fin r × (Fin n →₀ ℕ)) → (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) → Prop)
    (hwitness : ∀ t ∈ s, ∃ Q ∈ N, H t Q ∧ IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m Q t)
    (hcover : ∀ P ∈ N, ∀ t, IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m P t →
      ∃ u ∈ s, u.1 = t.1 ∧ u.2 ≤ t.2) :
    ∃ G : {t // t ∈ s} → (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
      (∀ t, G t ∈ N ∧ H t.val (G t) ∧ IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m (G t) t.val) ∧
      Submodule.span (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (Set.range G) = N

name: AbelFormalization.exists_homogeneous_polynomialModule_generators_from_leadingCover

    (s : Finset (Fin r × (Fin n →₀ ℕ)))
    (hwitness : ∀ t ∈ s, ∃ P ∈ N, IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m P t)
    (hcover : ∀ P ∈ N, ∀ t, IsPolynomialModuleLeadingTerm m P t →

name: AbelFormalization.exists_uniform_finite_homogeneous_polynomialModule_generators
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_finite_homogeneous_polynomialModule_generators
    (m : MonomialOrder (Fin n)) (weight : Fin n → ℕ) (hweight : ∀ i, 0 < weight i)
    (shift : Fin r → ℤ) (h : ℤ → ℕ) :

      ∀ N : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
        IsWeightedPolynomialModuleHomogeneous weight shift N →
        (∀ degree : ℤ, Module.finrank K
          ((N.restrictScalars K ⊓ weightedPolynomialModulePiece weight shift degree) :
            Submodule K (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K)) = h degree) →
        ∃ S : Finset (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),
          (∀ P ∈ S, P ∈ N ∧ ∃ degree : ℤ,

      ∀ N : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) K) (Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin n) K),

name: AbelFormalization.finrank_projectionPullbackSlice_eq_add
statement:
theorem finrank_projectionPullbackSlice_eq_add
    (q : F →ₗ[K] E) (hq : Function.Surjective q) (W : Submodule K E)
    (sourceComponent : F →ₗ[K] F) (targetComponent : E →ₗ[K] E)
    (hcomponent : ∀ x, q (sourceComponent x) = targetComponent (q x))
    (htarget : ∀ x, targetComponent (targetComponent x) = targetComponent x)
    [FiniteDimensional K (projectionPullbackSlice q W sourceComponent)] :
    Module.finrank K (projectionPullbackSlice q W sourceComponent) =
      Module.finrank K
          ((LinearMap.ker q ⊓ LinearMap.range sourceComponent) : Submodule K F) +
        Module.finrank K (projectionTargetSlice W targetComponent)

    (sourceComponent : G →ₗ[K] G) (targetComponent : H →ₗ[K] H)
    (hcomponent : ∀ x, j (sourceComponent x) = targetComponent (j x))
    (htarget : ∀ x, targetComponent (targetComponent x) = targetComponent x) :
    Module.finrank K
        (projectionTargetSlice (LinearMap.range j) targetComponent) =
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range sourceComponent)

name: AbelFormalization.banachDivisionRemainder_mem_ker
statement:
theorem banachDivisionRemainder_mem_ker (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (hT : ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ < 1) (g : B) :
    banachDivisionRemainder Q s f hT g ∈ LinearMap.ker Q.toLinearMap

name: AbelFormalization.banachDivision_existsUnique
statement:
theorem banachDivision_existsUnique (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (hT : ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ < 1) (g : B) :
    ∃! q : B, Q (g - f * q) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.banachDivision_existsUnique_of_norm_mul_lt_one
statement:
theorem banachDivision_existsUnique_of_norm_mul_lt_one (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (hsmall : ‖Q‖ * ‖s - f‖ < 1) (g : B) :
    ∃! q : B, Q (g - f * q) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.banachDivision_identity
statement:
theorem banachDivision_identity (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hT : ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ < 1) (g : B) :
    g = f * banachDivisionQuotient Q s f hT g + banachDivisionRemainder Q s f hT g

name: AbelFormalization.divisionPerturbation_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisionPerturbation_apply (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f a : B) :
    divisionPerturbation Q s f a = Q ((s - f) * a)

name: AbelFormalization.norm_banachDivisionQuotient_le
statement:
theorem norm_banachDivisionQuotient_le (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (hT : ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ < 1) (g : B) :
    ‖banachDivisionQuotient Q s f hT g‖ ≤ ‖Q g‖ / (1 - ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖)

name: AbelFormalization.norm_banachDivisionQuotient_le_opNorm
statement:
theorem norm_banachDivisionQuotient_le_opNorm (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (hT : ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ < 1) (g : B) :
    ‖banachDivisionQuotient Q s f hT g‖ ≤
      ‖Q‖ * ‖g‖ / (1 - ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖)

name: AbelFormalization.norm_banachDivisionRemainder_le
statement:
theorem norm_banachDivisionRemainder_le (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (hT : ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ < 1) (g : B) :
    ‖banachDivisionRemainder Q s f hT g‖ ≤
      ‖g‖ + ‖f‖ * (‖Q‖ * ‖g‖ / (1 - ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖))

name: AbelFormalization.norm_divisionPerturbation_le
statement:
theorem norm_divisionPerturbation_le (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B) :
    ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ ≤ ‖Q‖ * ‖s - f‖

name: AbelFormalization.one_sub_divisionPerturbation_apply
statement:
theorem one_sub_divisionPerturbation_apply (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (a : B) :
    (1 - divisionPerturbation Q s f : B →L[ℝ] B) a = Q (f * a)

name: AbelFormalization.opNorm_banachDivisionQuotient_le
statement:
theorem opNorm_banachDivisionQuotient_le (Q : B →L[ℝ] B) (s f : B)
    (hs : ∀ a : B, Q (s * a) = a) (hT : ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖ < 1) :
    ‖banachDivisionQuotient Q s f hT‖ ≤ ‖Q‖ / (1 - ‖divisionPerturbation Q s f‖)

name: AbelFormalization.idealHeight_comap_le_of_hasGoingDown
statement:
theorem idealHeight_comap_le_of_hasGoingDown {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [IsNoetherianRing S] [Algebra.HasGoingDown R S] (I : Ideal S) :
    (I.comap (algebraMap R S)).height ≤ I.height

name: AbelFormalization.idealHeight_localization_under
statement:
theorem idealHeight_localization_under (M : Submonoid R) {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [IsLocalization M S] (J : Ideal S) :
    (J.comap (algebraMap R S)).height = J.height

name: AbelFormalization.mvPolynomial_height_map_C
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_height_map_C (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map (MvPolynomial.C (σ := ι))).height = I.height

name: AbelFormalization.mvPolynomial_prime_height_map_C
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_prime_height_map_C (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    (p.map (MvPolynomial.C (σ := ι))).height = p.height

name: AbelFormalization.laurentExtension_height_map
statement:
theorem laurentExtension_height_map (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι R) (LaurentExtension ι R)).comp
      MvPolynomial.C)).height = I.height

name: AbelFormalization.laurentIdealHeight_map
statement:
theorem laurentIdealHeight_map (I : Ideal R)
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra (MvPolynomial ι R) S]
    [IsLocalization (laurentVariableSubmonoid ι R) S] :
    (I.map ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι R) S).comp MvPolynomial.C)).height = I.height

name: AbelFormalization.laurentIdealHeight_map_algebraMap
statement:
theorem laurentIdealHeight_map_algebraMap (I : Ideal R)
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra (MvPolynomial ι R) S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsScalarTower R (MvPolynomial ι R) S]
    [IsLocalization (laurentVariableSubmonoid ι R) S] :
    (I.map (algebraMap R S)).height = I.height

name: AbelFormalization.mvPolynomial_extension_cancel_monomial
AbelFormalization.mvPolynomial_extension_under_laurent_localization
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_extension_under_laurent_localization (I : Ideal R)
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra (MvPolynomial ι R) S]
    [IsLocalization (laurentVariableSubmonoid ι R) S] :
    ((I.map MvPolynomial.C).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι R) S)).comap
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι R) S) = I.map MvPolynomial.C

name: AbelFormalization.laurentPolynomial_comap_cancel_X
statement:
theorem laurentPolynomial_comap_cancel_X (J : Ideal (LaurentPolynomial R))
    (f : R[X]) (hf : Polynomial.X * f ∈ J.comap Polynomial.toLaurent) :
    f ∈ J.comap Polynomial.toLaurent

name: AbelFormalization.laurentPolynomial_mem_map_C_iff
statement:
theorem laurentPolynomial_mem_map_C_iff (I : Ideal R) (f : LaurentPolynomial R) :
    f ∈ I.map LaurentPolynomial.C ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, f.coeff n ∈ I

name: AbelFormalization.polynomialIdeal_height_map_C
statement:
theorem polynomialIdeal_height_map_C (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map Polynomial.C).height = I.height

name: AbelFormalization.polynomial_toLaurent_coeff_neg
statement:
theorem polynomial_toLaurent_coeff_neg (f : R[X]) (n : ℤ) (hn : n < 0) :
    (Polynomial.toLaurent f).coeff n = 0

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebraC_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupAlgebraC_apply (a : R) :
    groupAlgebraC R G a = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 a

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebra_homogeneousIdeal_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem groupAlgebra_homogeneousIdeal_coeff_mem [DecidableEq G]
    (K : Ideal (AddMonoidAlgebra R G))
    (hK : K.IsHomogeneous (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R))
    {f : AddMonoidAlgebra R G} (hf : f ∈ K) (g : G) :
    f.coeff g ∈ K.comap (groupAlgebraC R G)

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebra_homogeneousIdeal_eq_map_comap
statement:
theorem groupAlgebra_homogeneousIdeal_eq_map_comap [DecidableEq G]
    (K : Ideal (AddMonoidAlgebra R G))
    (hK : K.IsHomogeneous (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R)) :
    K = (K.comap (groupAlgebraC R G)).map (groupAlgebraC R G)

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebra_homogeneous_iff_single
statement:
theorem groupAlgebra_homogeneous_iff_single (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) :
    SetLike.IsHomogeneousElem (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R) f ↔
      ∃ g : G, ∃ a : R, AddMonoidAlgebra.single g a = f

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebra_homogeneous_mem_map_comap
statement:
theorem groupAlgebra_homogeneous_mem_map_comap
    (K : Ideal (AddMonoidAlgebra R G)) {f : AddMonoidAlgebra R G}
    (hhom : SetLike.IsHomogeneousElem (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R) f)
    (hf : f ∈ K) :
    f ∈ (K.comap (groupAlgebraC R G)).map (groupAlgebraC R G)

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebra_inverse_single_mul
statement:
theorem groupAlgebra_inverse_single_mul (g : G) (a : R) :
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-g) (1 : R) * AddMonoidAlgebra.single g a =
      groupAlgebraC R G a

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebra_mem_grade_zero_iff
statement:
theorem groupAlgebra_mem_grade_zero_iff (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) :
    f ∈ AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R (0 : G) ↔
      ∃ a : R, groupAlgebraC R G a = f

name: AbelFormalization.groupAlgebra_mem_map_C_iff
statement:
theorem groupAlgebra_mem_map_C_iff (I : Ideal R) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R G) :
    f ∈ I.map (groupAlgebraC R G) ↔ ∀ g : G, f.coeff g ∈ I

name: AbelFormalization.multivariateLaurentSuccEquiv_comp_C
statement:
theorem multivariateLaurentSuccEquiv_comp_C (h : ℕ) :
    (multivariateLaurentSuccEquiv R h).toRingHom.comp
      (groupAlgebraC R (Fin (h + 1) → ℤ)) =
    LaurentPolynomial.C.comp (groupAlgebraC R (Fin h → ℤ))

name: AbelFormalization.multivariateLaurentSuccEquiv_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem multivariateLaurentSuccEquiv_single (h : ℕ)
    (d : Fin (h + 1) → ℤ) (a : R) :
    multivariateLaurentSuccEquiv R h (AddMonoidAlgebra.single d a) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (d 0) (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (fun i => d i.succ) a)

name: AbelFormalization.multivariateLaurent_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem multivariateLaurent_isNoetherian (h : ℕ) :
    IsNoetherianRing (AddMonoidAlgebra R (Fin h → ℤ))

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentDenominatorExponent_nonneg
AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentExponentHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteLaurentExponentHom_apply (h : ℕ) (d : Fin h →₀ ℕ) (i : Fin h) :
    finiteLaurentExponentHom h d i = (d i : ℤ)

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentExponentHom_injective
statement:
theorem finiteLaurentExponentHom_injective (h : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (finiteLaurentExponentHom h)

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentExponentHom_natExponent
statement:
theorem finiteLaurentExponentHom_natExponent {h : ℕ} (g : Fin h → ℤ)
    (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ g i) :
    finiteLaurentExponentHom h (finiteLaurentNatExponent g) = g

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentNatExponent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteLaurentNatExponent_apply {h : ℕ} (g : Fin h → ℤ) (i : Fin h) :
    finiteLaurentNatExponent g i = (g i).toNat

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_X (h : ℕ) (i : Fin h) :
    finiteLaurentPolynomialHom R h (MvPolynomial.X i) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single
        (finiteLaurentExponentHom h (Finsupp.single i 1)) (1 : R)

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_clear_denominators
statement:
theorem finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_clear_denominators (h : ℕ)
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R (Fin h → ℤ)) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial (Fin h) R, ∃ d : Fin h →₀ ℕ,
      f * finiteLaurentPolynomialHom R h (MvPolynomial.monomial d 1) =
        finiteLaurentPolynomialHom R h p

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_injective
statement:
theorem finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_injective (h : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (finiteLaurentPolynomialHom R h)

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_monomial (h : ℕ) (d : Fin h →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    finiteLaurentPolynomialHom R h (MvPolynomial.monomial d c) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (finiteLaurentExponentHom h d) c

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentPolynomial_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteLaurentPolynomial_algebraMap (h : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin h) R) :
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin h) R) (AddMonoidAlgebra R (Fin h → ℤ)) p =
      finiteLaurentPolynomialHom R h p

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurent_monomial_mem_variableSubmonoid
statement:
theorem finiteLaurent_monomial_mem_variableSubmonoid (h : ℕ) (d : Fin h →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.monomial d (1 : R) ∈ laurentVariableSubmonoid (Fin h) R

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurent_single_isUnit
statement:
theorem finiteLaurent_single_isUnit (h : ℕ) (g : Fin h → ℤ) :
    IsUnit (AddMonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : R))

name: AbelFormalization.finsupp_weight_add
statement:
theorem finsupp_weight_add (ω ν : ι → ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (fun i => ω i + ν i) d =
      Finsupp.weight ω d + Finsupp.weight ν d

name: AbelFormalization.finsupp_weight_neg
statement:
theorem finsupp_weight_neg (ω : ι → ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (fun i => -ω i) d = -Finsupp.weight ω d

name: AbelFormalization.laurentExponentShear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentExponentShear_apply (ω : ι → ℤ) (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    laurentExponentShear ω (n, d) = (n + Finsupp.weight ω d, d)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentExponentShear_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentExponentShear_symm_apply (ω : ι → ℤ) (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (laurentExponentShear ω).symm (n, d) = (n - Finsupp.weight ω d, d)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentPolynomialFlatten_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentPolynomialFlatten_coeff
    (f : LaurentPolynomial (MvPolynomial ι R)) (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (laurentPolynomialFlatten f).coeff (n, d) = (f.coeff n).coeff d

name: AbelFormalization.laurentPolynomialFlatten_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentPolynomialFlatten_monomial (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    laurentPolynomialFlatten
      (LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.monomial d c) * LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (n, d) c

name: AbelFormalization.laurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_coeff
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R (ℤ × (ι →₀ ℕ))) (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ((laurentPolynomialFlatten.symm f).coeff n).coeff d =
      f.coeff (n, d)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_single (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    laurentPolynomialFlatten.symm (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (n, d) c) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.monomial d c) * LaurentPolynomial.T n

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_C_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_C_C (ω : ι → ℤ) (c : R) :
    laurentWeightRescaling ω (LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.C c)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_C_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_C_X (ω : ι → ℤ) (i : ι) :
    laurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω (LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X i) * LaurentPolynomial.T (ω i)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_T
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_T (ω : ι → ℤ) (n : ℤ) :
    laurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω (LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T n

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_coeff (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (f : LaurentPolynomial (MvPolynomial ι R)) (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ((laurentWeightRescaling ω f).coeff n).coeff d =
      (f.coeff (n - Finsupp.weight ω d)).coeff d

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_monomial (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    laurentWeightRescaling ω
      (LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.monomial d c) * LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.monomial d c) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (n + Finsupp.weight ω d)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_symm
statement:
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_symm (ω : ι → ℤ) :
    (laurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω).symm =
      laurentWeightRescaling (fun i => -ω i)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_symm_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_symm_monomial (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    (laurentWeightRescaling ω).symm
      (LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.monomial d c) * LaurentPolynomial.T n) =
      LaurentPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.monomial d c) *
        LaurentPolynomial.T (n - Finsupp.weight ω d)

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_trans
statement:
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_trans (ω ν : ι → ℤ) :
    (laurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω).trans (laurentWeightRescaling ν) =
      laurentWeightRescaling (fun i => ω i + ν i)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentExponentShear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentExponentShear_apply (ω : ι → G)
    (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    groupLaurentExponentShear ω (g, d) = (g + Finsupp.weight ω d, d)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentExponentShear_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentExponentShear_symm_apply (ω : ι → G)
    (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (groupLaurentExponentShear ω).symm (g, d) =
      (g - Finsupp.weight ω d, d)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_coeff
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra (MvPolynomial ι R) G) (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten f).coeff (g, d) = (f.coeff g).coeff d

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_single_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_single_monomial
    (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten (AddMonoidAlgebra.single g (MvPolynomial.monomial d c)) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (g, d) c

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_coeff
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R (G × (ι →₀ ℕ))) (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ((groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten.symm f).coeff g).coeff d = f.coeff (g, d)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten_symm_single
    (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    groupLaurentPolynomialFlatten.symm (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (g, d) c) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single g (MvPolynomial.monomial d c)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_coeff
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_coeff (ω : ι → G)
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra (MvPolynomial ι R) G) (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ((groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω f).coeff g).coeff d =
      (f.coeff (g - Finsupp.weight ω d)).coeff d

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_C (ω : ι → G) (c : R) :
    groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (MvPolynomial.C c)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_X (ω : ι → G) (i : ι) :
    groupLaurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (ω i) (MvPolynomial.X i)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_monomial (ω : ι → G)
    (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω (AddMonoidAlgebra.single g (MvPolynomial.monomial d c)) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (g + Finsupp.weight ω d) (MvPolynomial.monomial d c)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_single_one (ω : ι → G) (g : G) :
    groupLaurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω (AddMonoidAlgebra.single g 1) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single g 1

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_symm
statement:
theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_symm (ω : ι → G) :
    (groupLaurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω).symm =
      groupLaurentWeightRescaling (fun i => -ω i)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_symm_single_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_symm_single_monomial (ω : ι → G)
    (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    (groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω).symm
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single g (MvPolynomial.monomial d c)) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (g - Finsupp.weight ω d) (MvPolynomial.monomial d c)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_trans
statement:
theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_trans (ω ν : ι → G) :
    (groupLaurentWeightRescaling (R := R) ω).trans (groupLaurentWeightRescaling ν) =
      groupLaurentWeightRescaling (fun i => ω i + ν i)

name: AbelFormalization.group_finsupp_weight_add
statement:
theorem group_finsupp_weight_add (ω ν : ι → G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (fun i => ω i + ν i) d =
      Finsupp.weight ω d + Finsupp.weight ν d

name: AbelFormalization.group_finsupp_weight_neg
statement:
theorem group_finsupp_weight_neg (ω : ι → G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (fun i => -ω i) d = -Finsupp.weight ω d

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentRescaledCoefficientHom_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLaurentRescaledCoefficientHom_X (ω : ι → G) (i : ι) :
    groupLaurentRescaledCoefficientHom (R := R) ω (MvPolynomial.X i) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-ω i) (MvPolynomial.X i)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentRescaledContraction_eq
statement:
theorem groupLaurentRescaledContraction_eq (ω : ι → G)
    (K : Ideal (AddMonoidAlgebra (MvPolynomial ι R) G)) :
    groupLaurentRescaledContraction ω K =
      (K.map (groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω).toRingHom).comap
        (groupAlgebraC (MvPolynomial ι R) G)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightComponent_coeff
statement:
theorem groupLaurentWeightComponent_coeff (ω : ι → G) (α : G)
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra (MvPolynomial ι R) G) (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    ((groupLaurentWeightComponent ω α f).coeff g).coeff d =
      if g + Finsupp.weight ω d = α then (f.coeff g).coeff d else 0

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightComponent_rescaling
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLaurentWeightComponent_rescaling (ω : ι → G) (α : G)
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra (MvPolynomial ι R) G) :
    groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω (groupLaurentWeightComponent ω α f) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single α ((groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω f).coeff α)

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightRescaling_symm_coeff
statement:
theorem groupLaurentWeightRescaling_symm_coeff (ω : ι → G)
    (f : AddMonoidAlgebra (MvPolynomial ι R) G) (g : G) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (((groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω).symm f).coeff g).coeff d =
      (f.coeff (g + Finsupp.weight ω d)).coeff d

name: AbelFormalization.groupLaurentWeightedIdeal_rescaled_eq_map
statement:
theorem groupLaurentWeightedIdeal_rescaled_eq_map (ω : ι → G)
    (K : Ideal (AddMonoidAlgebra (MvPolynomial ι R) G))
    (hK : ∀ f ∈ K, ∀ α, groupLaurentWeightComponent ω α f ∈ K) :
    K.map (groupLaurentWeightRescaling ω).toRingHom =
      (groupLaurentRescaledContraction ω K).map
        (groupAlgebraC (MvPolynomial ι R) G)

name: AbelFormalization.exists_support_weight_eq_minimum
statement:
theorem exists_support_weight_eq_minimum (ω : ι → ℤ)
    {f : MvPolynomial ι R} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d ∈ f.support, Finsupp.weight ω d = minimumSupportWeight ω f

name: AbelFormalization.minimumSupportWeight_le
statement:
theorem minimumSupportWeight_le (ω : ι → ℤ) (f : MvPolynomial ι R)
    {d : ι →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ∈ f.support) :
    minimumSupportWeight ω f ≤ Finsupp.weight ω d

name: AbelFormalization.minimumSupportWeight_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minimumSupportWeight_zero (ω : ι → ℤ) :
    minimumSupportWeight ω (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.weightedNormalize_eval_zero
statement:
theorem weightedNormalize_eval_zero (ω : ι → ℤ) (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    (weightedNormalize ω f).eval 0 =
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω (minimumSupportWeight ω f) f

name: AbelFormalization.weightedNormalize_exponent_cast
statement:
theorem weightedNormalize_exponent_cast (ω : ι → ℤ) (f : MvPolynomial ι R)
    {d : ι →₀ ℕ} (hd : d ∈ f.support) :
    (((Finsupp.weight ω d - minimumSupportWeight ω f).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      Finsupp.weight ω d - minimumSupportWeight ω f

name: AbelFormalization.weightedNormalize_toLaurent
statement:
theorem weightedNormalize_toLaurent (ω : ι → ℤ) (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    Polynomial.toLaurent (weightedNormalize ω f) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (-minimumSupportWeight ω f) *
        laurentWeightRescaling ω (LaurentPolynomial.C f)

name: AbelFormalization.weightedNormalize_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedNormalize_zero (ω : ι → ℤ) :
    weightedNormalize ω (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.exists_support_lexicographicWeight_eq_minimum
statement:
theorem exists_support_lexicographicWeight_eq_minimum (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    {f : MvPolynomial ι R} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ d ∈ f.support,
      Finsupp.weight (fun i => toLex (ω i)) d = lexicographicMinimumWeight ω f

name: AbelFormalization.finLex_cons_lt_iff
statement:
theorem finLex_cons_lt_iff (a b : ℤ) (u v : Fin h → ℤ) :
    toLex (Fin.cons a u : Fin (h + 1) → ℤ) <
      toLex (Fin.cons b v : Fin (h + 1) → ℤ) ↔
      a < b ∨ a = b ∧ toLex u < toLex v

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialForm_coeff
statement:
theorem lexicographicInitialForm_coeff (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (f : MvPolynomial ι R) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (lexicographicInitialForm ω f).coeff d =
      if Finsupp.weight (fun i => toLex (ω i)) d = lexicographicMinimumWeight ω f
      then f.coeff d else 0

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialForm_support
statement:
theorem lexicographicInitialForm_support (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    (lexicographicInitialForm ω f).support =
      f.support.filter (fun d =>
        Finsupp.weight (fun i => toLex (ω i)) d = lexicographicMinimumWeight ω f)

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialForm_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lexicographicInitialForm_zero (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ) :
    lexicographicInitialForm ω (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialForm_zero_dim
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lexicographicInitialForm_zero_dim (ω : ι → Fin 0 → ℤ)
    (f : MvPolynomial ι R) : lexicographicInitialForm ω f = f

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicMinimumWeight_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lexicographicMinimumWeight_zero (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ) :
    lexicographicMinimumWeight ω (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicWeight_apply
statement:
theorem lexicographicWeight_apply (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (j : Fin h) :
    ofLex (Finsupp.weight (fun i => toLex (ω i)) d) j =
      Finsupp.weight (fun i => ω i j) d

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicWeight_cons
statement:
theorem lexicographicWeight_cons (ω : ι → ℤ) (ν : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (fun i => toLex (Fin.cons (ω i) (ν i))) d =
      toLex (Fin.cons (Finsupp.weight ω d)
        (ofLex (Finsupp.weight (fun i => toLex (ν i)) d)) : Fin (h + 1) → ℤ)

name: AbelFormalization.ideal_notMem_minimalPrimes_of_cancel
AbelFormalization.ordinaryHomogenizationContraction_cancel_X
statement:
theorem ordinaryHomogenizationContraction_cancel_X (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (f : Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (hf : Polynomial.X * f ∈ ordinaryHomogenizationContraction I) :
    f ∈ ordinaryHomogenizationContraction I

name: AbelFormalization.weightedDeformationIdeal_cancel_X
statement:
theorem weightedDeformationIdeal_cancel_X (ω : ι → ℤ) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (f : Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (hf : Polynomial.X * f ∈ weightedDeformationIdeal ω I) :

name: AbelFormalization.laurentWeightRescaling_exponent_nonneg_of_toLaurent
statement:
theorem laurentWeightRescaling_exponent_nonneg_of_toLaurent
    (ω : ι → ℤ) (F : LaurentPolynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (hF : laurentWeightRescaling ω F = p.toLaurent)
    (n : ℤ) (d : ι →₀ ℕ) (hd : (F.coeff n).coeff d ≠ 0) :
    0 ≤ n + Finsupp.weight ω d

name: AbelFormalization.minimumSupportWeight_add_nonneg_of_toLaurent
statement:
theorem minimumSupportWeight_add_nonneg_of_toLaurent
    (ω : ι → ℤ) (F : LaurentPolynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (hF : laurentWeightRescaling ω F = p.toLaurent)
    (n : ℤ) (hn : F.coeff n ≠ 0) :
    0 ≤ n + minimumSupportWeight ω (F.coeff n)

name: AbelFormalization.weightedDeformationIdeal_eq_span_normalize
statement:
theorem weightedDeformationIdeal_eq_span_normalize (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) :
    weightedDeformationIdeal ω I =
      Ideal.span (weightedNormalize ω '' (I : Set (MvPolynomial ι R)))

name: AbelFormalization.weightedDeformationIdeal_mem_span_normalize
statement:
theorem weightedDeformationIdeal_mem_span_normalize (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R))
    {p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι R)} (hp : p ∈ weightedDeformationIdeal ω I) :
    p ∈ Ideal.span (weightedNormalize ω '' (I : Set (MvPolynomial ι R)))

name: AbelFormalization.weightedDeformationSpecialization_eq_initialIdeal
statement:
theorem weightedDeformationSpecialization_eq_initialIdeal (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) :
    weightedDeformationSpecialization ω I = weightedInitialIdeal ω I

name: AbelFormalization.weightedNormalize_mem_weightedDeformationIdeal
statement:
theorem weightedNormalize_mem_weightedDeformationIdeal (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) {f : MvPolynomial ι R} (hf : f ∈ I) :
    weightedNormalize ω f ∈ weightedDeformationIdeal ω I

name: AbelFormalization.weightedNormalize_mul_X_toLaurent
statement:
theorem weightedNormalize_mul_X_toLaurent (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (f : MvPolynomial ι R) (n : ℤ)
    (hn : 0 ≤ n + minimumSupportWeight ω f) :
    (Polynomial.X ^ (n + minimumSupportWeight ω f).toNat * weightedNormalize ω f).toLaurent =
      laurentWeightRescaling ω (LaurentPolynomial.C f * LaurentPolynomial.T n)

name: AbelFormalization.minimumSupportWeight_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem minimumSupportWeight_of_homogeneous (ω : ι → ℤ)
    {α : ℤ} {f : MvPolynomial ι R} (hf : f.IsWeightedHomogeneous ω α)
    (hne : f ≠ 0) : minimumSupportWeight ω f = α

name: AbelFormalization.sum_weightedHomogeneousComponent_support
statement:
theorem sum_weightedHomogeneousComponent_support [DecidableEq M] (ω : ι → M)
    (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    (∑ α ∈ f.support.image (Finsupp.weight ω),
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α f) = f

name: AbelFormalization.weightedHomogeneousComponent_preserves_homogeneity
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponent_preserves_homogeneity
    (ω : ι → M) (ν : ι → N) (α : M) {β : N} {f : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (hf : f.IsWeightedHomogeneous ν β) :
    (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α f).IsWeightedHomogeneous ν β

name: AbelFormalization.weightedHomogeneousComponents_commute
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneousComponents_commute (ω : ι → M) (ν : ι → N)
    (α : M) (β : N) (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α
        (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ν β f) =
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ν β
        (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α f)

name: AbelFormalization.weightedInitialIdeal_component_mem
statement:
theorem weightedInitialIdeal_component_mem (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) {g : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (hg : g ∈ weightedInitialIdeal ω I) (α : ℤ) :
    MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α g ∈ weightedInitialIdeal ω I

name: AbelFormalization.weightedInitialIdeal_eq_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedInitialIdeal_eq_of_homogeneous (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (hI : I.IsHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R ω)) :
    weightedInitialIdeal ω I = I

name: AbelFormalization.weightedInitialIdeal_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedInitialIdeal_isHomogeneous (ω : ι → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) :
    (weightedInitialIdeal ω I).IsHomogeneous
      (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R ω)

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialForm_mem_initialIdeal
statement:
theorem lexicographicInitialForm_mem_initialIdeal (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) {f : MvPolynomial ι R} (hf : f ∈ I) :
    lexicographicInitialForm ω f ∈ lexicographicInitialIdeal ω I

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialForm_of_component
statement:
theorem lexicographicInitialForm_of_component
    (ω : ι → ℤ) (ν : ι → Fin h → ℤ) (α : ℤ) (g : MvPolynomial ι R)
    (hne : MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α
      (lexicographicInitialForm ν g) ≠ 0) :
    lexicographicInitialForm ν (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α g) =
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousComponent ω α (lexicographicInitialForm ν g)

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialIdeal_zero_dim
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lexicographicInitialIdeal_zero_dim (ω : ι → Fin 0 → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) : lexicographicInitialIdeal ω I = I

name: AbelFormalization.isWeightedHomogeneous_neg_group
AbelFormalization.lexicographicInitialForm_isWeightedHomogeneous
statement:
theorem lexicographicInitialForm_isWeightedHomogeneous {h : ℕ}
    (ν : σ → Fin h → ℤ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (lexicographicInitialForm ν f).IsWeightedHomogeneous ν
      (ofLex (lexicographicMinimumWeight ν f))

name: AbelFormalization.lexicographicWeight_ofLex
statement:
theorem lexicographicWeight_ofLex {h : ℕ} (ν : σ → Fin h → ℤ)
    (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    ofLex (Finsupp.weight (fun i => toLex (ν i)) d) = Finsupp.weight ν d

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_C (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A)
    (ν : σ → G) (r : R) :
    weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν (MvPolynomial.C r) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 (c r)

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_X (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A)
    (ν : σ → G) (i : σ) :
    weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν (MvPolynomial.X i) =

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_lexicographicInitial_eq_map_comap
statement:
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_lexicographicInitial_eq_map_comap {h : ℕ}
    (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A) (ν : σ → Fin h → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    (lexicographicInitialIdeal ν I).map (weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν) =
      (((lexicographicInitialIdeal ν I).map (weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν)).comap
        (groupAlgebraC A (Fin h → ℤ))).map (groupAlgebraC A (Fin h → ℤ))

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_lexicographicInitial_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_lexicographicInitial_isHomogeneous {h : ℕ}
    (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A) (ν : σ → Fin h → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    ((lexicographicInitialIdeal ν I).map
      (weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν)).IsHomogeneous (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade A)

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_monomial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_monomial (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A)
    (ν : σ → G) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R) :
    weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν (MvPolynomial.monomial d r) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Finsupp.weight ν d)
        (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom c a (MvPolynomial.monomial d r))

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_neg_lexicographicInitial_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_neg_lexicographicInitial_isHomogeneous {h : ℕ}
    (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A) (ν : σ → Fin h → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    ((lexicographicInitialIdeal ν I).map
      (weightedGroupEvaluation c a (fun i => -ν i))).IsHomogeneous
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade A)

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_of_homogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_of_homogeneous (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A)
    (ν : σ → G) {α : G} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (hf : f.IsWeightedHomogeneous ν α) :
    weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν f =

name: AbelFormalization.weightedGroupEvaluation_span_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedGroupEvaluation_span_isHomogeneous [DecidableEq G]
    (c : R →+* A) (a : σ → A) (ν : σ → G)
    (s : Set (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (hs : ∀ f ∈ s, ∃ α, f.IsWeightedHomogeneous ν α) :
    ((Ideal.span s).map (weightedGroupEvaluation c a ν)).IsHomogeneous
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade A)

name: AbelFormalization.centralLaurentContraction_eq
statement:
theorem centralLaurentContraction_eq (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin h ⊕ ι) R)) :
    centralLaurentContraction ω I =
      ((lexicographicInitialIdeal (centralLaurentWeight ω) I).map
        (centralLaurentRescaledMap ω)).comap
          (groupAlgebraC (MvPolynomial ι R) (Fin h → ℤ))

name: AbelFormalization.centralLaurentPolynomialMap_height_le
statement:
theorem centralLaurentPolynomialMap_height_le
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin h ⊕ ι) R)) :
    I.height ≤ (I.map (centralLaurentPolynomialMap R ι h)).height

name: AbelFormalization.centralLaurentRescaledMap_eq_evaluation
statement:
theorem centralLaurentRescaledMap_eq_evaluation (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ) :
    centralLaurentRescaledMap (R := R) ω =
      weightedGroupEvaluation MvPolynomial.C
        (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin h => (1 : MvPolynomial ι R)) MvPolynomial.X)
        (fun i => -centralLaurentWeight ω i)

name: AbelFormalization.centralLaurent_initial_eq_map_contraction
statement:
theorem centralLaurent_initial_eq_map_contraction (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin h ⊕ ι) R)) :
    (lexicographicInitialIdeal (centralLaurentWeight ω) I).map
        (centralLaurentRescaledMap ω) =
      (centralLaurentContraction ω I).map
        (groupAlgebraC (MvPolynomial ι R) (Fin h → ℤ))

name: AbelFormalization.centralLaurent_rescaled_initial_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem centralLaurent_rescaled_initial_isHomogeneous (ω : ι → Fin h → ℤ)
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin h ⊕ ι) R)) :
    ((lexicographicInitialIdeal (centralLaurentWeight ω) I).map
      (centralLaurentRescaledMap ω)).IsHomogeneous
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade (MvPolynomial ι R))

name: AbelFormalization.finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteLaurentPolynomialHom_C (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (h : ℕ) (a : A) :
    finiteLaurentPolynomialHom A h (MvPolynomial.C a) =

name: AbelFormalization.polynomialCoordinateTranslation_C

theorem polynomialCoordinateTranslation_C {σ : Type*} (c : σ → R) (a : R) :

name: AbelFormalization.polynomialCoordinateTranslation_X

name: AbelFormalization.IsAbel.exists_complex_extension
statement:
theorem exists_complex_extension {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ,
      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (Metric.ball (x : ℂ) r) ∧

name: AbelFormalization.exists_complex_extension_of_analyticAt
statement:
theorem exists_complex_extension_of_analyticAt {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ}

    ∃ F : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ F (x : ℂ) ∧

name: AbelFormalization.exists_complex_extension_on_ball_of_analyticAt
statement:
theorem exists_complex_extension_on_ball_of_analyticAt {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ}

      AnalyticOnNhd ℂ F (Metric.ball (x : ℂ) r) ∧
        ∀ y : ℝ, y ∈ Metric.ball x r → F (y : ℂ) = (f y : ℂ)

name: AbelFormalization.BoundedComplexExtension.mono
AbelFormalization.IsAbel.uniform_complex_extensions_fundamental
statement:
theorem uniform_complex_extensions_fundamental {U : ℝ} (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc U (E U), BoundedComplexExtension A x ρ M

name: AbelFormalization.exists_local_bounded_complex_extensions
statement:
theorem exists_local_bounded_complex_extensions {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x : ℝ}

name: AbelFormalization.exists_uniform_bounded_complex_extensions
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_bounded_complex_extensions {f : ℝ → ℝ} {K : Set ℝ}

    (hν : 0 < toLex ν)
    (horder : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, StrictAnti (fun i => u i n))

    (hR : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 2 ≤ R n)

    [Fintype Original] [Nonempty Original]
    {l : Filter X} {Rscale Xscale : X → Real}
    (source central error normalization : Canonical → X → Complex)
    (centralGenerator : Central → X → Complex)
    (centralCoefficient : Central → Canonical → X → Complex)
    (originalGenerator : Original → X → Complex)
    (sourceCoefficient : Canonical → Original → X → Complex)
    (hR : ∀ᶠ x in l, 1 ≤ Rscale x)
    (hRX : ∀ᶠ x in l, Rscale x ≤ Xscale x)
    (hcentralIdentity : ∀ᶠ x in l, ∀ b,
      centralGenerator b x =
        ∑ a, centralCoefficient b a x * central a x)
    (hcentralCoefficient :
      HasUniformComplexPolynomialUpperBound l Rscale centralCoefficient)
    (hcentralLower :
      HasComplexInversePowerLowerBound l Rscale centralGenerator)
    (hexpansion : ∀ᶠ x in l, ∀ a,
      normalization a x * source a x = central a x + error a x)
    (herror : ∀ a, ComplexSuperpolynomialDecay l Rscale (error a))
    {Cnormalization : Real} (hCnormalization : 0 < Cnormalization)
    {Pnormalization : Nat}
    (hnormalization : ∀ᶠ x in l, ∀ a,
      ‖normalization a x‖ ≤
        Cnormalization * (Xscale x) ^ Pnormalization)
    (hsourceIdentity : ∀ᶠ x in l, ∀ a,
      source a x =
        ∑ j, sourceCoefficient a j x * originalGenerator j x)
    (hsourceCoefficient :
      HasUniformComplexPolynomialUpperBound l Xscale sourceCoefficient) :
    HasComplexInversePowerLowerBound l Xscale originalGenerator

theorem fderiv_graphLiftSystem

name: AbelFormalization.graphBlockCLM_apply

    (hdenominator : ∀ i, denominator i ∈ B)
    (hnumerator : ∀ i, numerator i ∈ B) (i : κ) :
    finiteCommonClearedNumerator denominator numerator i ∈ B

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominator_eq_mul_prod_erase
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominator_eq_mul_prod_erase
    {S κ : Type*} [CommMonoid S] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (denominator : κ → S) (i : κ) :
    finiteCommonDenominator denominator =
      denominator i * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i), denominator j

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominator_mem_subalgebra
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominator_mem_subalgebra
    {X κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (B : Subalgebra ℝ (X → ℝ)) (denominator : κ → X → ℝ)
    (hdenominator : ∀ i, denominator i ∈ B) :
    finiteCommonDenominator denominator ∈ B

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominator_mul_eq_clearedNumerator
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominator_mul_eq_clearedNumerator
    {S κ : Type*} [CommMonoid S] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (denominator numerator old : κ → S)
    (hcoordinate : ∀ i, denominator i * old i = numerator i)
    (i : κ) :
    finiteCommonDenominator denominator * old i =
      finiteCommonClearedNumerator denominator numerator i

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominator_pos
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominator_pos
    {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    (denominator : κ → ℝ) (hdenominator : ∀ i, 0 < denominator i) :

name: AbelFormalization.finsupp_weight_neg_one
statement:
theorem finsupp_weight_neg_one (d : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    Finsupp.weight (fun _ : ι => (-1 : ℤ)) d =
      -((d.sum (fun _ n => n) : ℕ) : ℤ)

name: AbelFormalization.fullOrdinaryHomogenization_cancel_X
statement:
theorem fullOrdinaryHomogenization_cancel_X (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (f : Polynomial (MvPolynomial ι R))
    (hf : Polynomial.X * f ∈ fullOrdinaryHomogenization I) :

name: AbelFormalization.fullOrdinaryHomogenization_eq_contraction
statement:
theorem fullOrdinaryHomogenization_eq_contraction
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) :
    fullOrdinaryHomogenization I = ordinaryHomogenizationContraction I

name: AbelFormalization.minimumSupportWeight_neg_one
statement:
theorem minimumSupportWeight_neg_one (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    minimumSupportWeight (fun _ : ι => (-1 : ℤ)) f = -(f.totalDegree : ℤ)

name: AbelFormalization.ordinaryHomogenize_eval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordinaryHomogenize_eval_one (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :

name: AbelFormalization.ordinaryHomogenize_mem_fullOrdinaryHomogenization
statement:
theorem ordinaryHomogenize_mem_fullOrdinaryHomogenization
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R)) {f : MvPolynomial ι R} (hf : f ∈ I) :

name: AbelFormalization.ordinaryHomogenize_toLaurent
statement:
theorem ordinaryHomogenize_toLaurent (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    Polynomial.toLaurent (ordinaryHomogenize f) =
      LaurentPolynomial.T (f.totalDegree : ℤ) *
        laurentWeightRescaling (fun _ : ι => (-1 : ℤ)) (LaurentPolynomial.C f)

name: AbelFormalization.ordinaryHomogenize_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordinaryHomogenize_zero : ordinaryHomogenize (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.weightedNormalize_neg_one
statement:
theorem weightedNormalize_neg_one (f : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    weightedNormalize (fun _ : ι => (-1 : ℤ)) f = ordinaryHomogenize f

name: AbelFormalization.denominatorClearedMvPolynomialEval_mem_subalgebra
statement:
theorem denominatorClearedMvPolynomialEval_mem_subalgebra
    {X R σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (B : Subalgebra ℝ (X → ℝ))
    (D : ℕ) (c : R →+* (X → ℝ)) (delta : X → ℝ)
    (num : σ → X → ℝ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (hc : ∀ d, d ∈ P.support → c (P.coeff d) ∈ B)
    (hdelta : delta ∈ B)
    (hnum : ∀ d, d ∈ P.support → ∀ i, i ∈ d.support → num i ∈ B) :
    denominatorClearedMvPolynomialEval D c delta num P ∈ B

name: AbelFormalization.mvPolynomial_totalDegree_le_familyTotalDegree
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_totalDegree_le_familyTotalDegree
    {R σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ}
    (Q : Fin n → MvPolynomial σ R) (i : Fin n) :
    (Q i).totalDegree ≤ mvPolynomialFamilyTotalDegree Q

name: AbelFormalization.pow_mul_eval₂_eq_denominatorClearedMvPolynomialEval
statement:
theorem pow_mul_eval₂_eq_denominatorClearedMvPolynomialEval
    {R S σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (D : ℕ) (c : R →+* S) (delta : S) (old num : σ → S)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (hD : P.totalDegree ≤ D)
    (hvar : ∀ i, delta * old i = num i) :
    delta ^ D * MvPolynomial.eval₂ c old P =
      denominatorClearedMvPolynomialEval D c delta num P

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialEval_mem_subalgebra
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialEval_mem_subalgebra
    {X R σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
    (B : Subalgebra ℝ (X → ℝ))
    (D : ℕ) (c : R →+* (X → ℝ))
    (denominator numerator : σ → X → ℝ)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (hc : ∀ d, d ∈ P.support → c (P.coeff d) ∈ B)
    (hdenominator : ∀ i, denominator i ∈ B)
    (hnumerator : ∀ i, numerator i ∈ B) :
    finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialEval D c denominator numerator P ∈ B

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialFamilyEval_mem_subalgebra
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialFamilyEval_mem_subalgebra
    {X R σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {n : ℕ}
    (B : Subalgebra ℝ (X → ℝ))
    (c : R →+* (X → ℝ))
    (denominator numerator : σ → X → ℝ)
    (Q : Fin n → MvPolynomial σ R)
    (hc : ∀ row d, d ∈ (Q row).support → c ((Q row).coeff d) ∈ B)
    (hdenominator : ∀ i, denominator i ∈ B)
    (hnumerator : ∀ i, numerator i ∈ B)
    (row : Fin n) :
    finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialFamilyEval
      c denominator numerator Q row ∈ B

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominator_family_pow_mul_eval₂_eq
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominator_family_pow_mul_eval₂_eq
    {R S σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {n : ℕ}
    (c : R →+* S) (denominator numerator old : σ → S)
    (Q : Fin n → MvPolynomial σ R)
    (hcoordinate : ∀ i, denominator i * old i = numerator i)
    (row : Fin n) :
    finiteCommonDenominator denominator ^ mvPolynomialFamilyTotalDegree Q *
        MvPolynomial.eval₂ c old (Q row) =
      finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialFamilyEval
        c denominator numerator Q row

name: AbelFormalization.finiteCommonDenominator_pow_mul_eval₂_eq
statement:
theorem finiteCommonDenominator_pow_mul_eval₂_eq
    {R S σ : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]
    (D : ℕ) (c : R →+* S)
    (denominator numerator old : σ → S)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (hD : P.totalDegree ≤ D)
    (hcoordinate : ∀ i, denominator i * old i = numerator i) :
    finiteCommonDenominator denominator ^ D * MvPolynomial.eval₂ c old P =
      finiteCommonDenominatorMvPolynomialEval D c denominator numerator P

name: AbelFormalization.fderiv_implicitGraphLiftSystem
statement:
theorem fderiv_implicitGraphLiftSystem
    {Ftilde : E × ℝ → F} {h : E × ℝ → ℝ}
    {x : E} {z : ℝ}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ftilde (x, z))
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h (x, z)) :
    fderiv ℝ (implicitGraphLiftSystem Ftilde h) (x, z) =
      implicitGraphBlockCLM
        (graphLiftXBlock (fderiv ℝ Ftilde (x, z)))
        (graphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ Ftilde (x, z)))
        (graphLiftXBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, z)))
        (graphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, z)))

name: AbelFormalization.implicitGraphBlockCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem implicitGraphBlockCLM_apply
    (A : E →L[ℝ] F) (B : ℝ →L[ℝ] F)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (u : E) (v : ℝ) :
    implicitGraphBlockCLM A B C D (u, v) =
      (A u + B v, C u + D v)

name: AbelFormalization.implicitGraph_tangent_identity
statement:
theorem implicitGraph_tangent_identity
    {h : E × ℝ → ℝ} {zeta : E → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h (x, zeta x))
    (hzeta : DifferentiableAt ℝ zeta x)
    (hgraph : (fun y ↦ h (y, zeta y)) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun _ : E ↦ (0 : ℝ))) :
    ∀ u,
      graphLiftXBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, zeta x)) u +
        graphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, zeta x))
          (fderiv ℝ zeta x u) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.mem_regularZeroSet_implicitGraphLift_iff
statement:
theorem mem_regularZeroSet_implicitGraphLift_iff
    {Omega : Set E} {Ftilde : E × ℝ → F}
    {h : E × ℝ → ℝ} {zeta : E → ℝ} {x : E}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ftilde (x, zeta x))
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h (x, zeta x))
    (hzeta : DifferentiableAt ℝ zeta x)
    (hgraph : (fun y ↦ h (y, zeta y)) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun _ : E ↦ (0 : ℝ)))
    (hvertical : Function.Surjective
      (graphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, zeta x)))) :
    x ∈ regularZeroSet Omega (graphSubstitution Ftilde zeta) ↔
      (x, zeta x) ∈ regularZeroSet
        ((fun p : E × ℝ ↦ p.1) ⁻¹' Omega)
        (implicitGraphLiftSystem Ftilde h)

name: AbelFormalization.surjective_implicitGraphBlockCLM_iff
statement:
theorem surjective_implicitGraphBlockCLM_iff
    (A : E →L[ℝ] F) (B : ℝ →L[ℝ] F)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (Z : E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hD : Function.Surjective D)
    (htangent : ∀ u, C u + D (Z u) = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (implicitGraphBlockCLM A B C D) ↔
      Function.Surjective (graphReducedCLM A B Z)

name: AbelFormalization.fderiv_finiteGraphSubstitution
statement:
theorem fderiv_finiteGraphSubstitution
    {Ftilde : E × G → F} {zeta : E → G} {x : E}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ftilde (x, zeta x))
    (hzeta : DifferentiableAt ℝ zeta x) :
    fderiv ℝ (finiteGraphSubstitution Ftilde zeta) x =
      finiteGraphReducedCLM
        (finiteGraphLiftXBlock (fderiv ℝ Ftilde (x, zeta x)))
        (finiteGraphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ Ftilde (x, zeta x)))
        (fderiv ℝ zeta x)

name: AbelFormalization.fderiv_finiteImplicitGraphLiftSystem
statement:
theorem fderiv_finiteImplicitGraphLiftSystem
    {Ftilde : E × G → F} {h : E × G → G} {x : E} {z : G}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ftilde (x, z))
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h (x, z)) :
    fderiv ℝ (finiteImplicitGraphLiftSystem Ftilde h) (x, z) =
      finiteImplicitGraphBlockCLM
        (finiteGraphLiftXBlock (fderiv ℝ Ftilde (x, z)))
        (finiteGraphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ Ftilde (x, z)))
        (finiteGraphLiftXBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, z)))
        (finiteGraphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, z)))

name: AbelFormalization.finiteGraphLift_blocks_apply
statement:
theorem finiteGraphLift_blocks_apply
    (T : (E × G) →L[ℝ] F) (u : E) (v : G) :
    T (u, v) = finiteGraphLiftXBlock T u + finiteGraphLiftZBlock T v

name: AbelFormalization.finiteGraphReducedCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteGraphReducedCLM_apply
    (A : E →L[ℝ] F) (B : G →L[ℝ] F)
    (Z : E →L[ℝ] G) (u : E) :
    finiteGraphReducedCLM A B Z u = A u + B (Z u)

name: AbelFormalization.finiteGraphTangentCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteGraphTangentCLM_apply (Z : E →L[ℝ] G) (u : E) :
    finiteGraphTangentCLM Z u = (u, Z u)

name: AbelFormalization.finiteImplicitGraphBlockCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteImplicitGraphBlockCLM_apply
    (A : E →L[ℝ] F) (B : G →L[ℝ] F)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] G) (D : G →L[ℝ] G)
    (u : E) (v : G) :
    finiteImplicitGraphBlockCLM A B C D (u, v) =
      (A u + B v, C u + D v)

name: AbelFormalization.finiteImplicitGraph_tangent_identity
statement:
theorem finiteImplicitGraph_tangent_identity
    {h : E × G → G} {zeta : E → G} {x : E}
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h (x, zeta x))
    (hzeta : DifferentiableAt ℝ zeta x)
    (hgraph : (fun y ↦ h (y, zeta y)) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun _ : E ↦ (0 : G))) :
    ∀ u,
      finiteGraphLiftXBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, zeta x)) u +
        finiteGraphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, zeta x))
          (fderiv ℝ zeta x u) = 0

name: AbelFormalization.mem_regularZeroSet_finiteImplicitGraphLift_iff
statement:
theorem mem_regularZeroSet_finiteImplicitGraphLift_iff
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ G]
    {Omega : Set E} {Ftilde : E × G → F}
    {h : E × G → G} {zeta : E → G} {x : E}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ftilde (x, zeta x))
    (hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h (x, zeta x))
    (hzeta : DifferentiableAt ℝ zeta x)
    (hgraph : (fun y ↦ h (y, zeta y)) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun _ : E ↦ (0 : G)))
    (hvertical : Function.Surjective
      (finiteGraphLiftZBlock (fderiv ℝ h (x, zeta x)))) :
    x ∈ regularZeroSet Omega (finiteGraphSubstitution Ftilde zeta) ↔
      (x, zeta x) ∈ regularZeroSet
        ((fun p : E × G ↦ p.1) ⁻¹' Omega)
        (finiteImplicitGraphLiftSystem Ftilde h)

name: AbelFormalization.surjective_finiteImplicitGraphBlockCLM_iff
statement:
theorem surjective_finiteImplicitGraphBlockCLM_iff
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ G]
    (A : E →L[ℝ] F) (B : G →L[ℝ] F)
    (C : E →L[ℝ] G) (D : G →L[ℝ] G)
    (Z : E →L[ℝ] G)
    (hD : Function.Surjective D)
    (htangent : ∀ u, C u + D (Z u) = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (finiteImplicitGraphBlockCLM A B C D) ↔
      Function.Surjective (finiteGraphReducedCLM A B Z)

name: AbelFormalization.mem_regularZeroSet_finiteExplicitGraphLift_iff
statement:
theorem mem_regularZeroSet_finiteExplicitGraphLift_iff
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ G]
    {Omega : Set E} {Ftilde : E × G → F}
    {zeta : E → G} {x : E}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ftilde (x, zeta x))
    (hzeta : DifferentiableAt ℝ zeta x) :
    x ∈ regularZeroSet Omega (finiteGraphSubstitution Ftilde zeta) ↔
      (x, zeta x) ∈ regularZeroSet
        ((fun p : E × G ↦ p.1) ⁻¹' Omega)
        (finiteExplicitGraphLiftSystem Ftilde zeta)

name: AbelFormalization.surjective_finiteGraphLiftZBlock_fderiv_finiteExplicitGraphEquation
statement:
theorem surjective_finiteGraphLiftZBlock_fderiv_finiteExplicitGraphEquation
    {zeta : E → G} {x : E} (hzeta : DifferentiableAt ℝ zeta x) :
    Function.Surjective
      (finiteGraphLiftZBlock
        (fderiv ℝ (finiteExplicitGraphEquation zeta) (x, zeta x)))

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_boundaryIndex_succ
statement:
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_boundaryIndex_succ
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c)
    (c : Fin clusterCount) (i : Fin (length c)) :
    family.concatenate (boundaryIndex length hpositive c i.succ) =
      family.boundary c i.succ

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_boundaryIndex_terminal
statement:
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_boundaryIndex_terminal
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c) (c : Fin clusterCount) :
    family.concatenate
        (boundaryIndex length hpositive c (Fin.last (length c))) =
      family.boundary c (Fin.last (length c))

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_first
statement:
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_first
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c) (hcount : 0 < clusterCount) :
    family.concatenate
        (boundaryIndex length hpositive ⟨0, hcount⟩ 0) =
      family.boundary ⟨0, hcount⟩ 0

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_last
statement:
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_last
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c) (hcount : 0 < clusterCount) :
    family.concatenate (Fin.last (totalCount length)) =
      family.boundary (lastClusterIndex hcount)
        (Fin.last (length (lastClusterIndex hcount)))

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_seam
statement:
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_seam
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c)
    {c next : Fin clusterCount} (hnext : next.val = c.val + 1) :
    family.concatenate
        (boundaryIndex length hpositive c (Fin.last (length c))) =
      family.boundary next 0

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.concatenate_zero
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A) :
    family.concatenate 0 = family.initial

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.natFamily_succ_flattenIndex
statement:
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.natFamily_succ_flattenIndex
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c)
    (c : Fin clusterCount) (i : Fin (length c)) :
    family.natFamily ((flattenIndex length c i : ℕ) + 1) =
      family.boundary c i.succ

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.natFamily_total
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.natFamily_total
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A) :
    family.natFamily (totalCount length) =
      family.concatenate (Fin.last (totalCount length))

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.CompatibleBoundaryFamily.natFamily_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CompatibleBoundaryFamily.natFamily_zero
    {clusterCount : ℕ} {length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ} {A : Type*}
    (family : CompatibleBoundaryFamily length A) :
    family.natFamily 0 = family.initial

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.boundaryIndex_first
statement:
theorem boundaryIndex_first {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c) (hcount : 0 < clusterCount) :
    boundaryIndex length hpositive ⟨0, hcount⟩ 0 = 0

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.boundaryIndex_last
statement:
theorem boundaryIndex_last {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c) (hcount : 0 < clusterCount) :
    boundaryIndex length hpositive (lastClusterIndex hcount)
        (Fin.last (length (lastClusterIndex hcount))) =
      Fin.last (totalCount length)

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.boundaryIndex_succ
statement:
theorem boundaryIndex_succ {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c)
    (c : Fin clusterCount) (i : Fin (length c)) :
    boundaryIndex length hpositive c i.succ =
      (flattenIndex length c i).succ

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.boundaryIndex_terminal_eq_initial
statement:
theorem boundaryIndex_terminal_eq_initial {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c)
    {c next : Fin clusterCount} (hnext : next.val = c.val + 1) :
    boundaryIndex length hpositive c (Fin.last (length c)) =
      boundaryIndex length hpositive next 0

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.boundaryIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem boundaryIndex_val {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (length : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (hpositive : ∀ c, 0 < length c)
    (c : Fin clusterCount) (i : Fin (length c + 1)) :
    (boundaryIndex length hpositive c i : ℕ) =
      prefixOffset length c.castSucc + i

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.clampBoundary_of_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clampBoundary_of_le {total j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ total) :
    clampBoundary total j = ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h⟩

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.clusterTransferIndex_extraRetained_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clusterTransferIndex_extraRetained_val
    {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (individualCount extraRetainedCount : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (c : Fin clusterCount) (i : Fin (extraRetainedCount c)) :
    (clusterTransferIndex individualCount extraRetainedCount c
        (.extraRetained i) : ℕ) =
      prefixOffset
          (clusterTransferLength individualCount extraRetainedCount)
          c.castSucc + individualCount c + 1 + i

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.clusterTransferIndex_firstSimultaneous_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clusterTransferIndex_firstSimultaneous_val
    {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (individualCount extraRetainedCount : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (c : Fin clusterCount) :
    (clusterTransferIndex individualCount extraRetainedCount c
        .firstSimultaneous : ℕ) =
      prefixOffset
          (clusterTransferLength individualCount extraRetainedCount)
          c.castSucc + individualCount c

name: AbelFormalization.FiniteFamilyFlattening.clusterTransferIndex_individual_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clusterTransferIndex_individual_val
    {clusterCount : ℕ}
    (individualCount extraRetainedCount : Fin clusterCount → ℕ)
    (c : Fin clusterCount) (i : Fin (individualCount c)) :
    (clusterTransferIndex individualCount extraRetainedCount c
        (.individual i) : ℕ) =
      prefixOffset
          (clusterTransferLength individualCount extraRetainedCount)
          c.castSucc + i

name: AbelFormalization.exists_finiteWeightDescent_stabilizes
statement:
theorem exists_finiteWeightDescent_stabilizes
    (J : (∀ i, M i) ≃ₗ[R] (∀ i, M i))
    (htri : ∀ i (v : M i), J (Pi.single i v) = Pi.single i v +
      finiteWeightPrefixProjection R M i.val (J (Pi.single i v)))
    (N₀ : Submodule R (∀ i, M i))
    (hN₀ : ∀ x ∈ N₀, ∀ i, Pi.single i (x i) ∈ N₀) :
    ∃ j₀ : ℕ, (finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₀).map J.toLinearMap =
        finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₀ ∧
      ∀ j, j₀ ≤ j → finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j = finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₀

    (hN₀ : ∀ x ∈ N₀, ∀ i, Pi.single i (x i) ∈ N₀) (j : ℕ) :
    ∀ x ∈ finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j, ∀ i,
      Pi.single i (x i) ∈ finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j

name: AbelFormalization.finiteWeightDescentIterate_permanent

    (hJN : (finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₀).map J.toLinearMap =
      finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₀) :

    (J : (∀ i, M i) ≃ₗ[R] (∀ i, M i))
    (htri : ∀ i (v : M i),
      J (Pi.single i v) = Pi.single i v +
        finiteWeightPrefixProjection R M i.val (J (Pi.single i v)))
    (K : Submodule R (∀ i, M i))
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, Pi.single i (x i) ∈ K)
    (hJK : K.map J.toLinearMap = K) :
    ∀ i (v : finiteWeightCoordinateSubmodule K i),
      finiteWeightInvariantCoordinateEquiv J K hK hJK (Pi.single i v) =
        Pi.single i v +
          finiteWeightPrefixProjection R
            (fun i ↦ finiteWeightCoordinateSubmodule K i) i.val
            (finiteWeightInvariantCoordinateEquiv J K hK hJK
              (Pi.single i v))

theorem map_finiteWeightCoordinate_descentIterate_eq

statement:
theorem finiteWeightRestrictedEquivOfInvariant_triangular
    (J : (∀ i, M i) ≃ₗ[R] (∀ i, M i))

    (K : Submodule R (∀ i, M i))

        (U.map (finiteWeightRestrictedPiQuotientMap K b)) j) :

statement:
theorem exists_finiteWeightDescent_minimalLocalization_sandwich
    (d : ℕ)
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Ring.KrullDimLE (d + 1) R]
    [∀ i, Module.Finite R (M i)]
    (J : (∀ i, M i) ≃ₗ[R] (∀ i, M i))
    (htri : ∀ i (v : M i), J (Pi.single i v) = Pi.single i v +
      finiteWeightPrefixProjection R M i.val (J (Pi.single i v)))
    (N₀ : Submodule R (∀ i, M i))
    (hN₀ : ∀ x ∈ N₀, ∀ i, Pi.single i (x i) ∈ N₀) :
    ∃ (j₁ : ℕ) (K : Submodule R (∀ i, M i)) (b : R),
      (∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, b ∉ p) ∧
      Ring.KrullDimLE d (R ⧸ Ideal.span {b}) ∧
      K.FG ∧
      (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, Pi.single i (x i) ∈ K) ∧
      K.map J.toLinearMap = K ∧
      b • K ≤ finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₁ ∧
      finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₁ ≤ K ∧
      (finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₁).localized'
          (Localization (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R))
          (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R)
          (finiteWeightLocalizationMap
            (M := M) (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R)) =
        K.localized'
          (Localization (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R))
          (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R)
          (finiteWeightLocalizationMap
            (M := M) (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R)) ∧
      ∀ j, j₁ ≤ j →
        (finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j).localized'
            (Localization (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R))
            (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R)
            (finiteWeightLocalizationMap
              (M := M) (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R)) =
          (finiteWeightDescentIterate J N₀ j₁).localized'
            (Localization (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R))
            (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R)
            (finiteWeightLocalizationMap
              (M := M) (minimalPrimeAvoidanceSubmonoid R))

    (hQ : ∀ ζ ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) R, Q.eval ζ ≠ 0) (hd : 0 < Q.natDegree)
    (z : ℂ) :

    (hQ : ∀ ζ ∈ sphere (0 : ℂ) R, Q.eval ζ ≠ 0) (hd : 0 < Q.natDegree)
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ball (0 : ℂ) R) :

    ∃ threshold : ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ, threshold ≤ s → s + c + 1 ≤ T s

    (hlarge : ∃ r : ℝ, 2 ≤ T r) (k : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ threshold : ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ, threshold ≤ s →
      (Real.exp^[k]) (s + c) + 1 ≤ T s

    (hQdegree : Q.degree < (totalMultiplicity m : WithBot ℕ))

statement:
theorem exists_local_contDiffOn_flat_parameterization_of_mem_firstNonflatStratum
    {a b n s : ℕ} {g : (Fin a → ℝ) → (Fin b → ℝ)}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ (s + n : ℕ) g) (hs : 0 < s) (hn : 0 < n)
    {x : Fin a → ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ iteratedFDerivFirstNonflatStratum (n + 1) g) :
    ∃ U : Set (Fin a → ℝ), ∃ W : Set (Fin (a - 1) → ℝ),
      ∃ theta : (Fin (a - 1) → ℝ) → (Fin a → ℝ),
        IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ IsOpen W ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ s theta W ∧
          ContDiffOn ℝ s (g ∘ theta) W ∧
          (iteratedFDerivFirstNonflatStratum (n + 1) g ∩ U) ⊆
            theta '' W ∧
          g '' (iteratedFDerivFirstNonflatStratum (n + 1) g ∩ U) ⊆
            (g ∘ theta) ''
              (iteratedFDerivFlatSet (min (n + 1) (s + 1))
                (g ∘ theta) ∩ W)
